# VBO Advertising

> Founder-led marketing consultant and studio in Miami, serving small to mid-size businesses across South Florida.

VBO Advertising is a Miami-based marketing consultant and studio founded by Tim Bailey. A senior level marketer collaborates on strategy, sets your direction, and runs your program: a cutting edge system connected end to end, where modern tools carry the busywork of a traditional junior team and senior hours go into your business. VBO also helps clients get found in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and runs all of that on this site first.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.vboadv.com/): Brand positioning, who shows up when you hire VBO, and the full list of services and industries
- [Fractional CMO Services](https://www.vboadv.com/fractional-cmo): What a fractional CMO does, what it costs, and when a business needs one
- [AI-Enabled Marketing Consultancy](https://www.vboadv.com/ai-enabled-marketing): VBO's modern operational approach, comparing traditional vs AI-enabled vs AI-first operating models
- [Insights](https://www.vboadv.com/insights): VBO's blog on marketing strategy, creative, and performance

## Services

All ten services live on the [homepage](https://www.vboadv.com/), under Industries and Services.

- Web development: Custom sites, redesigns and Shopify stores, built to be found and fast on a phone. We built and launched the site for IPPE Soccer Tours.
- Marketing consulting: For when you want an answer, not a retainer. Someone senior reviews what's running and hands you a plan you can act on. Scoped, with an end date.
- Fractional CMO: A senior marketing head, part of the time. Same seat and the same responsibility for where the money goes, on a share of the hours.
- Ecommerce and Shopify: Paid media and search run together on the same store. Collection pages, product feeds and catalog structure, where Shopify money quietly leaks.
- AI SEO and visibility: Making your business readable and quotable for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers. We run all of it on this site first. You're welcome to check.
- Paid media: Meta, Google Search, Google Shopping and Performance Max. A small number of accounts with senior hands on all of them, which is most of the difference.
- AI-enabled marketing: How the work gets done, not something we sell you. Modern tools handle the repetitive parts so the senior thinking gets your attention. A person still decides.
- Analytics and reporting: Tracking installed before the first dollar goes out, so results get counted instead of guessed at. Then a short written update you can read in two minutes.
- Creative: Brand and campaign work: identity, design, ad creative, photography for social. We rebuilt the IPPE Soccer Tours brand alongside their site.
- Social media: The calendar, the copy, the design and the shooting, planned as one feed. Run with everything else, so the posts match what the ads and the site are saying.

## Industries

The industry list lives on the [homepage](https://www.vboadv.com/), under Industries and Services. Four professional-services verticals have their own pages.

- Fashion and apparel: Apparel sells in seasons and the marketing has to move on the same calendar. Spend hard in the weeks that matter, then collect the demand that never stops.
- Jewelry and luxury retail: A considered purchase is a different job. For a buyer who takes weeks to decide: a site that holds up to scrutiny and advertising paced for the wait.
- Food and beverage: For a small food brand, the maker is the brand. The site and the story get built around the person, and the advertising is sized to what the kitchen can serve.
- Sports and travel: When a parent is the buyer, trust comes before price. Real detail on every program you run, and tracking that shows which trips turn into inquiries.
- Local service businesses: Your whole market lives within a few miles, so the job changes. Getting picked on the map, looking as established as you are, and earning the fortieth visit.
- Law firms: Nobody hires a law firm off an ad alone. The site answers what people are nervous to ask, and search keeps you visible on the narrow terms that matter.
- Professional services: Med spas, dental practices, financial advisors. Selling judgment the buyer can't inspect first, so the work is making the expertise visible and easy to trust.
- Non-profit and education: Non-profits market to families and to funders at once, in two messages that can't contradict each other. Spend gets weighed against the mission it came from.
- Apps and digital products: The development, the landing site, the store listing, and the marketing that gets it downloaded. We shipped our own app, Sidefoot, to the App Store.
- [Marketing for Law Firms in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/law-firms): Vertical landing page for law firm marketing
- [Dental Practice Marketing in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/dental-practices): Vertical landing page for dental practice marketing
- [Medical Spa Marketing in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/med-spas): Vertical landing page for med spa and aesthetic clinic marketing
- [Financial Advisor Marketing in Miami](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/financial-advisors): Vertical landing page for financial advisor and RIA marketing
